title: India's ammonia industry: balancing growth with sustainability
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2026, Advance Article

Triya Mukherjee, Harishankar Kopperi, Poonam Kumari, Yamini Javvadi, Ranaprathap Katakojwala, S. Venkata Mohan, Swaminathan Sivaram
India's ammonia sector can be decarbonized through CCU, deploying low-carbon intensity H2 and renewable energy integration. Transitioning from conventional SMR to low-carbon intensity hydrogen pathways could reduce CO2 emissions by up to 87% by 2070.
